name: sidebar
summary: The column of links down the side of an app, in sections, with the current page marked and a rail of icons when collapsed.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Names the navigation for screen readers; not shown.

properties.name: current
properties.description: The label of the item that is the current page.

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: Collapses the sidebar to a rail of icons; each item keeps its label as its name.

slots.name: sections
slots.description: The items, in groups under an optional heading. An item has a label, an optional icon and badge, and is a link (it can be the current page), a button (an action, never current), or a group of nested links and buttons one level deep.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Above the items: a logo, product name or workspace menu. Clipped to the rail when collapsed.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Below the items: the signed-in person or an account menu. Clipped to the rail when collapsed.

events.name: press
events.description: An item is pressed, with its label.

events.name: collapsedChange
events.description: The person collapsed or expanded the sidebar, with the new state.

states.name: rest
states.description: Items in the foreground; the current one on an accent wash with a bar at the start edge.

states.name: hover
states.description: A pointer over an item shows the muted wash, distinct from the current item's.

states.name: focused
states.description: A ring around the focused item.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The item takes the muted wash instead of scaling, as a full-width row that shrinks reads as a jump.

accessibility.name: Its label names the navigation; each item by its label, a badge read after it ("Inbox 12"), the current one marked; a collapsed item by its label alone.
accessibility.keyboard: Each item is a tab stop; Enter and Space press it; a group's button shows or hides its nested items and reports whether it is expanded.
accessibility.web: A <nav> named by its label, of lists of links, the current one with aria-current="page"; a button item is a <button>; a group is a button with aria-expanded; section headings label their lists; collapsed, each icon item keeps its name and a tooltip.
accessibility.apple: A container named by its label, of sections whose headings are headers, of buttons named by their labels with the selected trait on the current one; a group is a button reading expanded or collapsed.
accessibility.windows: Like a NavigationView's list: UI Automation ControlType.List named by its label, of ListItems with SelectionItem, the current one selected, section headings as header items; a group is a ListItem with the ExpandCollapse pattern; a button item has the Invoke pattern.
accessibility.android: A list of nodes with Role.Button (a link and a button item alike, as Compose has no link role), the current one with the selected state, each named by its label with its badge, a click action and focus; section headings are headings; a group node has an expanded state.

cases.person: Spoonjoy at the top, then Recipes on an accent wash with a bar at its start edge, Inbox with a 12 badge, and a Library heading over Cookbooks.
A narrow rail of two icons, the Recipes icon on an accent wash.

deviations: Web's items are links (href) and the current one follows currentPath; native kits take a current label and a press handler, as an app navigates itself.
Below 640px web turns it into a menu button that opens a Sheet drawer; native kits leave that to the platform's own navigation.
On iPhone the app uses OuroTabBar; on iPad and Mac this is the sidebar column. Items are buttons with the selected trait, as SwiftUI has no link role.
Built on WinUI's NavigationView semantics, whose compact pane is the collapsed rail.
Drawn as a list of Role.Button nodes rather than Material's NavigationDrawerItem, which has no link role either; used on tablets and foldables, where a phone uses OuroTabBar.
